item.title: openclaw 2026.10.34
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of October 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.11.10

2026.10.34

This extended-stable patch updates the Gateway and official npm plugins from 2026.10.33. It includes the core npm package and Gateway Docker images, but no native-app releases.

Highlights

  • OpenAI and ClawRouter: select GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, with system-prompt caching on the OpenAI API-key and Sign in with ChatGPT Responses routes. (#200766, #201094) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @fuller-stack-dev, and @obviyus.
  • Tlon: group DMs use their own approval policy, and approved clubs remain authorized across Gateway restarts. (#202775) Thanks @joshavant.
  • Update recovery: avoid leaving the Gateway offline when an update runs alongside database readers or replaces a running checkout, and recover the service after a failed Windows update rolls back. (#201330, #202541, #203241, #203264) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Conversation continuity: deliver ready child results without waiting for other helpers to finish, and accept follow-up chat messages after the preceding run completes. (#203176, #203102, #201790) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Channel delivery: recover Telegram polling when update IDs reset, keep an undownloadable attachment from blocking replies, and reconnect all Discord accounts after a network outage. (#201167, #200682, #201415, #162189) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @mattreyes0824.

Changes

  • MiniMax: stop offering retired M2 models, including during live discovery, and use MiniMax-M3 for PDF text extraction. If your configuration explicitly selects an M2 model, switch it to a supported model. (#203998) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Access controls: apply the session permission mode consistently on Gateway tool calls, recheck bound Discord DMs against current policy, and keep Signal view-once attachments out of assistant context. (#202941, #196848, #196841) Thanks @obviyus and @drobison00.
  • Channel setup: save new tokens through the channel secret store rather than writing them to config as plaintext. (#201428, #175333) Thanks @anmol0b, @sallyom, and @masatohoshino.
  • Discord and Slack: queue independent Discord requests instead of replacing an active task, show when the target session is busy, and leave Slack question buttons available when a click comes from someone who cannot answer. (#201518, #201363, #201371, #201348) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @shannon0430.
  • Conversation delivery: return complete queued ACP replies, preserve Claude CLI final answers after progress messages, and avoid repeating tool work on a fallback model during long Claude CLI turns. (#202658, #200470, #200801, #200744) Thanks @obviyus, @chaeyn, @fede-kamel, and @jzmudzinski.
  • Conversation recovery: resume saved requests when transcript metadata advances, and keep pending child results when the requesting run ends or a follow-up takes over. (#201477, #195275) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @jalehman.
  • OpenAI and Codex: preserve session affinity for Sign in with ChatGPT and let Codex subagents start from agent folders with capital letters. (#197588, #197532, #201520, #201423) Thanks @sukhdeepjohar, @aatreya, @obviyus, and @thejeys19.
  • Provider reliability: compact before predicted context overflow instead of trimming tool results already cached by the provider, stop retrying Anthropic requests that require credits, and preserve user-configured model rows on provider sign-in. (#199530, #201997, #201742, #201558) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @LinzeShi, @MertBasar0, and @Caitoz.
  • Install and update: avoid hanging at NodeSource on Ubuntu 26.04, preserve pnpm-linked checkouts when switching to the npm release, and complete updates with read-only, unchanged config or old plugin leases. (#203538, #201701, #201331, #201314) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Storage and backups: let large PostgreSQL maintenance operations finish, recover after silent database connection loss, port upgraded stores to PostgreSQL, and reclaim space when backup staging databases are deleted. (#201869, #201856, #201299, #201250, #199666) Thanks @VACInc, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, and @etzelm.
  • Doctor: reuse the existing state database for offline update checks after backup, avoiding extra copies of large databases. (#202985) Authored by @steipete.
  • Browser and Control UI: capture background tabs in headed or headless Chrome, keep final answers out of the collapsed Worked fold, and preserve pending dictation transcripts while showing progress. (#202878, #165312, #201626, #197429, #200235) Thanks @obviyus, @titan550, @Marvinthebored, @vyctorbrzezowski, @Peetiegonzalez, and @daniel-lxs.
  • Automation and Feishu: deliver automation failure notices back to the chat that created the job and finish long replies in the same streaming card. (#203056, #161777, #139443) Thanks @obviyus, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.33..3656180a44de203e4b3be5fb02d768fcdb306767 history: 129 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 129 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

item.title: openclaw 2026.11.10-beta.3
item.description:
2026.11.10-beta.3

Highlights

  • Update recovery: Keep interrupted package and source updates recoverable, including updates that cross a schema change or restart the machine. (#200273) (#200366) (#200460) (#200866) (#200994) (#201600) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable delegated work: Keep completed subagent answers available across Gateway restarts and while sibling tasks are still running. (#200279) (#200649) (#200823) (#190999) (#201563) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @gouyu-hou, and @esqandil.
  • Responsive long-running chats: Reduce memory and main-thread work when compacting or opening large conversation histories. (#201304) (#188397) (#202234) (#202547) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman and @garrytan.
  • Private credentials and attachments: Preserve SecretRef-backed credentials when editing settings and avoid downloading Signal view-once attachments. (#200539) (#197319) (#201428) (#196841) Related #193149, #175333 Thanks @obviyus, @tommyjoseph, @mmaps, @anmol0b, @sallyom, @masatohoshino, and @drobison00.
  • Provider sign-in: Sign in to OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go in the browser and discover the models available to the signed-in account. (#202949) (#202976) Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.

Changes

  • Templates: Open a durable chat before completing verified template setup, and allow a previously deleted template agent to be added again. (#196392) (#200628) Related #198475 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
  • Plugin side questions: Let plugins fork live conversation context for hidden background turns, with session-policy-governed file access and execution. (#170146) (#190950) (#200636) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Managed installs: Keep releases in separate directories on OpenClaw-owned installations. (#198835) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Hooks: Accept hook bodies up to 1 MiB, report rejected bodies, and handle batched Gmail pushes. (#200514) (#130002) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.
  • MCP configuration: Apply saved MCP server changes from the CLI without stopping the Gateway. (#200582) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Model discovery: Refresh signed-in ChatGPT model availability independently of OpenClaw releases or npm, retain provider catalog details, and avoid advertising models omitted by the provider. (#201130) (#201493) (#202618) (#202490) (#167460) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @daniel-lxs.
  • MiniMax documents: Stop offering retired MiniMax models and enable PDF reading through the current model integration. (#203998) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Access boundaries: Preserve administrator permissions across native clients and prevent removed Discord DM senders from continuing through an old session binding. (#194443) (#196848) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @jjjhenriksen, @sallyom, and @drobison00.
  • Network and call boundaries: Bind realtime voice streams to signed calls and prevent self-hosted web endpoints or workspace Azure redirects from silently changing the destination host. (#136506) (#196847) (#202031) Thanks @drobison00 and @mmaps.
  • Session ownership: Keep requested sessions and automations assigned to the requester, preserve Telegram owner/account identity, and route owner-targeted failure alerts to the owner rather than the last chat. (#200952) (#201008) (#201159) (#189953) (#203409) Related #189947, #203403 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @obviyus, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @chelsealong, and @nousclawds4.
  • Restart delivery: Deliver final answers interrupted by a Gateway restart and resume persisted requests when transcript metadata advances. (#200553) (#201477) (#200924) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Subagent completion: Retain finished results when parents turn over, access-policy lookups fail, or sibling tasks are waiting; surface delivery failures instead of silently dropping work. (#195275) (#198807) (#200967) (#200249) (#200760) (#201460) (#201544) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @obviyus.
  • Subagent steering: Send new instructions to busy subagents promptly, retain original task instructions on retries, and let resumed parents collect interrupted children. (#200574) (#201636) (#202139) Related #201605 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @mike1122real-hub.
  • Queued conversations: Avoid duplicate queued follow-up answers, preserve active work when directives arrive, and answer messages sent immediately after a delayed stop reply. (#172810) (#201271) (#195612) (#201790) Related #194451, #194303 Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, @VACInc, @alexph-dev, @amittell, and @obviyus.
  • Claude CLI: Preserve final replies after large tool outputs or progress messages, retain long child completions, and avoid replaying side-effecting work on a fallback model after local output overflow. (#200501) (#166127) (#200470) (#200226) (#200801) (#192838) Related #186967, #199633, #200744, #192735 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @obviyus, @Trinity-AI-Coder, @RTapiador, @chaeyn, @etzelm, @VACInc, @mulderp82, @fede-kamel, @jzmudzinski, @yousan, and @slatem.
  • Codex conversations: Preserve media-only history, oversized instructions, streamed line breaks, and the native writer when conversations resume. (#185186) (#200690) (#200735) (#201102) (#201474) Related #185079 Thanks @RomneyDa, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, @kaguranananana, @obviyus, @UHDPass, @freeqaz, and @vincentkoc.
  • Codex setup and tools: Handle same-name MCP servers correctly, repair missing plugin runtime commands, verify standalone installers, and make library skills readable to remote app servers. (#194831) (#187427) (#201657) (#201491) (#201667) Related #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @lonexreb, @obviyus, @NicoBoom13, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @sallyom, @DonnieFi, and @freeqaz.
  • Provider requests: Preserve reasoning and thought signatures across compatible proxy tool calls, keep steering in its original position, and honor model-specific cooldowns and reasoning limits. (#186942) (#119783) (#202774) (#198736) (#203356) (#200446) Related #186842, #119591 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @wr-web, @obviyus, @bluet, @metaforismo, @Patrick-Erichsen, @wenyonglim, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Provider failures and pricing: Keep healthy fallback models available after missing-model errors, distinguish native host limits from provider rate limits, and stop reporting unknown prices as free. (#200946) (#202602) (#111175) (#201924) Thanks @machine3at, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @VACInc, @vyctorbrzezowski, @xydigit-zt, and @obviyus.
  • Tool calls: Preserve required arguments in compact tool hints, coerce quoted arguments consistently, retain complete Tool Search pages, and explain validation or truncation failures. (#200064) (#114461) (#193200) (#201487) (#201795) (#202272) Related #96115, #111704, #194857 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman, @cbertucci33, @pallaoro, @ayaangazali, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @lyrakat, and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Code Mode and execution: Keep foreground command output intact, let silent commands reach their own timeout, allow steering while a shell command runs, and warn before retrying an action whose reply was lost. (#202177) (#202852) (#200670) (#200998) (#201523) Related #202173 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sasan1200, @obviyus, and @VACInc.
  • Automations: Keep scheduled work running across session edits, group renames, sharing changes, upgrades, and Gateway restarts. (#200314) (#200396) (#199512) (#180891) (#201434) (#200653) (#201757) Related #200307, #200600 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @hannesrudolph, @obviyus, @daniel-lxs, and @VACInc.
  • Automation outcomes: Avoid duplicate cron replies and false failure notices after recovered tool calls, collected child results, or intentionally silent replies. (#201838) (#201638) (#139037) (#152165) (#186652) (#202142) (#164949) (#170534) Related #202140, #164887, #203821 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @hartmark, @pash-openai, @jalehman, @jayzhou2309, @Hensarj, and @ArthurBook.
  • Telegram and WhatsApp: Keep Telegram receiving after update IDs restart, answer around failed attachment downloads, avoid replaying old topic context, and prevent WhatsApp reconnect notices from filling the session queue. (#201167) (#200682) (#202542) (#202637) (#191037) Related #190640 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @VACInc, @ericcurtin, and @sercada.
  • Discord and Teams: Reconnect all Discord accounts after network outages, preserve independent requests, transcribe voice using live settings, and avoid duplicated or truncated Teams stream fallback replies. (#201415) (#201518) (#202362) (#202368) (#158429) Related #162189, #158103 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @ericcaiwx-star, and @rdbartram.
  • Matrix, Feishu, and Mattermost: Avoid treating quoted bot mentions as new turns, render Matrix polls, preserve long Feishu replies, and deliver callback-button interactions correctly. (#197091) (#191700) (#161777) (#201973) Related #197065, #191678, #139443 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Jo2234, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.
  • Voice and meetings: Keep meeting audio and captions active after join calls return, load existing Talk history, and support PostgreSQL-backed voice consultation indexes. (#191059) (#178415) (#201352) (#189036) (#189999) (#202103) Related #173896, #178413 Thanks @valkyriweb, @obviyus, @jeremynorris, @sukhdeepjohar, @davelutztx, @xena68, @ceckert, @etzelm, and @VACInc.
  • Browser and desktop: Read text from the correct page after navigation, preserve the user’s focused Chrome tab, capture background headless tabs, and keep desktop streams open during large updates. (#196659) (#134400) (#201626) (#202313) (#193487) Related #196658, #202267, #193444 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @martins-oss, @obviyus, @scotthuang, @honoyr, @SebTardif, and @lakemike.
  • Startup and pairing: Accept first chats while model catalogs load, keep readiness responsive, preserve startup restart handling, and show actionable pairing or setup guidance. (#201127) (#200370) (#201248) (#203530) (#202087) (#200905) (#202085) Related #202038, #202037 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @etzelm, @VACInc, @anmol0b, @LiuwqGit, and @sallyom.
  • Gateway responsiveness: Reduce stalls during plugin preparation and recovery, process launches, web extraction, filesystem pressure, and shell snapshot capture. (#200320) (#200374) (#198262) (#150564) (#197510) (#200925) (#201037) (#202407) Related #202374 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.
  • Database portability: Repair PostgreSQL schema-metadata mismatches, support ports back to SQLite, preserve backup restoration through symlinked targets, and handle large plugin blobs. (#197425) (#200383) (#201299) (#201867) (#197795) (#201862) (#201583) Related #196966, #200356, #201250, #197779, #201573 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @VACInc, @etzelm, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, @MasterSwords1, and @synapse-homeroot.
  • PostgreSQL reliability: Keep leases alive through lock contention, preserve the first operation after host suspension, speed up networked transcript migration, and retain numeric recall scores. (#201853) (#193875) (#201374) (#202304) (#201869) Related #201249 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @VACInc, @ceckert, @deepujain, and @evemorgen.
  • SQLite and disk usage: Release snapshot and backup staging disk space, prioritize queued chat writes over page cleanup, and avoid repeatedly copying live state during read-only inspection. (#199666) (#201661) (#201445) (#202608) (#202765) (#203850) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @etzelm, @VACInc, @Alix-007, and @vincentkoc.
  • Update interruptions: Recover interrupted package publication and source updates after reboot, retain uncertain cases on the repair path, and preserve the installed command when old wrappers cannot be removed. (#200550) (#200680) (#201009) (#201361) (#200579) (#200613) (#201735) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Update contention: Continue updates around short-lived database readers and writers, settle shutdown writes, and keep plugin-contract or advisory warnings from unnecessarily rolling back core updates. (#200742) (#200569) (#201545) (#201330) (#202541) (#200507) (#202414) (#202310) Related #198072, #200022, #202384 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @zzs12345-web, @damzaru, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @fulgerulnegru, and @Anurag-5ingh.
  • Update compatibility: Handle prior updater handoffs, legacy statistics, pnpm global-store layouts, and Windows staged plugin dependencies; keep package files readable by non-root services. (#200532) (#201314) (#201914) (#202017) (#200595) (#193272) Related #200508, #200573 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrietv, @Leon-SK668, @fuller-stack-dev, @desksk, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Update status: Preserve failed-update reports and Inbox history, distinguish repairs from success, keep status queries responsive, and show plugin restart countdowns beside the update that needs them. (#202558) (#202678) (#202692) (#200687) (#201354) (#200431) Related #202657 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @machine3at, @vincentkoc, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, @AyhamJo7, @hannesrudolph, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugin follow-up: Retry owed plugin updates on schedule without ignoring Hold, retain pending repair work, and resolve version-like npm tags correctly. (#201178) (#201355) (#201678) (#201829) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @vincentkoc.
  • Doctor and installation: Retain recovery copies, restore truncated configuration, keep old Matrix heartbeat recovery available, preserve shell setup instructions, and avoid hanging the Linux installer at NodeSource. (#202322) (#201501) (#202651) (#201383) (#203538) (#202385) (#202312) Related #202382, #202309 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sukhdeepjohar, @VACInc, @etzelm, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Control UI: Keep answers outside collapsed work details, preserve mobile sidebar sections and keyboard layout, reconnect after app switches, and show menus in the Linux app. (#197429) (#202256) (#201291) (#199887) (#202500) (#201892) Related #199875, #202467 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Marvinthebored, @vyctorbrzezowski, @Peetiegonzalez, @daniel-lxs, @obviyus, and @Mezetix.
  • Native apps: Avoid false low-memory failures on the first macOS chat, permit reopening after credential startup failures, keep iOS Talk replies ordered, and let Android Back dismiss the keyboard first. (#200373) (#201505) (#197136) (#202065) (#195974) Related #200340, #197129, #195949 Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @jjjhenriksen, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @vyctorbrzezowski, @fuller-stack-dev, @saariuslystoned, and @Solvely-Colin.
  • Worktrees and sandboxes: Keep delayed managed-clone sessions and inherited project folders usable, support mounted state for custom Docker users, and avoid overlapping SSH file-tool failures. (#202525) (#202839) (#202792) (#202353) (#201807) (#202815) Related #202021 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @qodelicious, @henrylast42, and @ngutman.
  • Knowledge and memory: Provide usable Knowledge call shapes, keep the scribe progressing, exclude execution wake output from session indexing, and avoid indexing unused tool lookups. (#200339) (#202724) (#201062) (#201519) Related #196857 Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Ricardodpalmeida.

Upcoming deprecations

The dates below are announced compatibility review/removal windows, not removals made by this beta. Existing removal-pending compatibility stays in place until its documented migration, published-reader, data-preservation, and approval requirements are met. Update integrations to the replacements below before their window.

  • plugin-sdk-session-agent-resolution-aliases — 2026-11-29: resolveSessionAgentIdsStrict and resolveSessionAgentIdStrict with an explicit agent, agent-scoped session key, prepared fallback, or persisted owner. See /plugins/compatibility#session-agent-resolution-aliases. Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • agent-harness-credential-prompt-string-argument — 2026-11-30: options object { controlToolsAvailable }. See /plugins/sdk-migration/removed-surfaces#credential-prompt-builder.

  • doctor-model-compat-catalog-ownership — 2026-11-29: provider catalog compat metadata, with config compat reserved for custom routes. See /gateway/config-tools.
  • doctor-tier-eval-tranche — 2026-11-29: canonical config owners, shared SQLite state, built-in defaults, and plugin hooks. See /gateway/doctor. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • doctor-final-layout-polish — 2026-11-29: canonical final layout and built-in defaults. See /gateway/doctor.
  • doctor-phase4-product-config-retirements — 2026-11-29: built-in rescue, marketplace, banner, and retired commitments behavior. See /gateway/doctor.
  • doctor-media-models-consolidation — 2026-11-29: capability-tagged tools.media.models plus per-capability policy and defaults. See /nodes/media-understanding.
  • doctor-runtime-tuning-knobs-purge — 2026-11-29: built-in runtime and channel defaults. See /gateway/doctor.
  • doctor-phase2-channel-dm-aliases — 2026-11-29: dmPolicy and allowFrom at the same channel or account level. See /cli/doctor.

item.content:encoded:
2026.11.10-beta.3

Highlights

  • Update recovery: Keep interrupted package and source updates recoverable, including updates that cross a schema change or restart the machine. (#200273) (#200366) (#200460) (#200866) (#200994) (#201600) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable delegated work: Keep completed subagent answers available across Gateway restarts and while sibling tasks are still running. (#200279) (#200649) (#200823) (#190999) (#201563) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @gouyu-hou, and @esqandil.
  • Responsive long-running chats: Reduce memory and main-thread work when compacting or opening large conversation histories. (#201304) (#188397) (#202234) (#202547) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman and @garrytan.
  • Private credentials and attachments: Preserve SecretRef-backed credentials when editing settings and avoid downloading Signal view-once attachments. (#200539) (#197319) (#201428) (#196841) Related #193149, #175333 Thanks @obviyus, @tommyjoseph, @mmaps, @anmol0b, @sallyom, @masatohoshino, and @drobison00.
  • Provider sign-in: Sign in to OpenCode Console and OpenCode Go in the browser and discover the models available to the signed-in account. (#202949) (#202976) Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.

Changes

  • Templates: Open a durable chat before completing verified template setup, and allow a previously deleted template agent to be added again. (#196392) (#200628) Related #198475 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
  • Plugin side questions: Let plugins fork live conversation context for hidden background turns, with session-policy-governed file access and execution. (#170146) (#190950) (#200636) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Managed installs: Keep releases in separate directories on OpenClaw-owned installations. (#198835) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Hooks: Accept hook bodies up to 1 MiB, report rejected bodies, and handle batched Gmail pushes. (#200514) (#130002) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.
  • MCP configuration: Apply saved MCP server changes from the CLI without stopping the Gateway. (#200582) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Model discovery: Refresh signed-in ChatGPT model availability independently of OpenClaw releases or npm, retain provider catalog details, and avoid advertising models omitted by the provider. (#201130) (#201493) (#202618) (#202490) (#167460) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @daniel-lxs.
  • MiniMax documents: Stop offering retired MiniMax models and enable PDF reading through the current model integration. (#203998) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Fixes

  • Access boundaries: Preserve administrator permissions across native clients and prevent removed Discord DM senders from continuing through an old session binding. (#194443) (#196848) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @jjjhenriksen, @sallyom, and @drobison00.
  • Network and call boundaries: Bind realtime voice streams to signed calls and prevent self-hosted web endpoints or workspace Azure redirects from silently changing the destination host. (#136506) (#196847) (#202031) Thanks @drobison00 and @mmaps.
  • Session ownership: Keep requested sessions and automations assigned to the requester, preserve Telegram owner/account identity, and route owner-targeted failure alerts to the owner rather than the last chat. (#200952) (#201008) (#201159) (#189953) (#203409) Related #189947, #203403 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @obviyus, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @chelsealong, and @nousclawds4.
  • Restart delivery: Deliver final answers interrupted by a Gateway restart and resume persisted requests when transcript metadata advances. (#200553) (#201477) (#200924) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
  • Subagent completion: Retain finished results when parents turn over, access-policy lookups fail, or sibling tasks are waiting; surface delivery failures instead of silently dropping work. (#195275) (#198807) (#200967) (#200249) (#200760) (#201460) (#201544) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @obviyus.
  • Subagent steering: Send new instructions to busy subagents promptly, retain original task instructions on retries, and let resumed parents collect interrupted children. (#200574) (#201636) (#202139) Related #201605 Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, and @mike1122real-hub.
  • Queued conversations: Avoid duplicate queued follow-up answers, preserve active work when directives arrive, and answer messages sent immediately after a delayed stop reply. (#172810) (#201271) (#195612) (#201790) Related #194451, #194303 Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @shakkernerd, @VACInc, @alexph-dev, @amittell, and @obviyus.
  • Claude CLI: Preserve final replies after large tool outputs or progress messages, retain long child completions, and avoid replaying side-effecting work on a fallback model after local output overflow. (#200501) (#166127) (#200470) (#200226) (#200801) (#192838) Related #186967, #199633, #200744, #192735 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @obviyus, @Trinity-AI-Coder, @RTapiador, @chaeyn, @etzelm, @VACInc, @mulderp82, @fede-kamel, @jzmudzinski, @yousan, and @slatem.
  • Codex conversations: Preserve media-only history, oversized instructions, streamed line breaks, and the native writer when conversations resume. (#185186) (#200690) (#200735) (#201102) (#201474) Related #185079 Thanks @RomneyDa, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, @kaguranananana, @obviyus, @UHDPass, @freeqaz, and @vincentkoc.
  • Codex setup and tools: Handle same-name MCP servers correctly, repair missing plugin runtime commands, verify standalone installers, and make library skills readable to remote app servers. (#194831) (#187427) (#201657) (#201491) (#201667) Related #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @lonexreb, @obviyus, @NicoBoom13, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @sallyom, @DonnieFi, and @freeqaz.
  • Provider requests: Preserve reasoning and thought signatures across compatible proxy tool calls, keep steering in its original position, and honor model-specific cooldowns and reasoning limits. (#186942) (#119783) (#202774) (#198736) (#203356) (#200446) Related #186842, #119591 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @VACInc, @wr-web, @obviyus, @bluet, @metaforismo, @Patrick-Erichsen, @wenyonglim, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
  • Provider failures and pricing: Keep healthy fallback models available after missing-model errors, distinguish native host limits from provider rate limits, and stop reporting unknown prices as free. (#200946) (#202602) (#111175) (#201924) Thanks @machine3at, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @VACInc, @vyctorbrzezowski, @xydigit-zt, and @obviyus.
  • Tool calls: Preserve required arguments in compact tool hints, coerce quoted arguments consistently, retain complete Tool Search pages, and explain validation or truncation failures. (#200064) (#114461) (#193200) (#201487) (#201795) (#202272) Related #96115, #111704, #194857 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman, @cbertucci33, @pallaoro, @ayaangazali, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @lyrakat, and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Code Mode and execution: Keep foreground command output intact, let silent commands reach their own timeout, allow steering while a shell command runs, and warn before retrying an action whose reply was lost. (#202177) (#202852) (#200670) (#200998) (#201523) Related #202173 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sasan1200, @obviyus, and @VACInc.
  • Automations: Keep scheduled work running across session edits, group renames, sharing changes, upgrades, and Gateway restarts. (#200314) (#200396) (#199512) (#180891) (#201434) (#200653) (#201757) Related #200307, #200600 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @hannesrudolph, @obviyus, @daniel-lxs, and @VACInc.
  • Automation outcomes: Avoid duplicate cron replies and false failure notices after recovered tool calls, collected child results, or intentionally silent replies. (#201838) (#201638) (#139037) (#152165) (#186652) (#202142) (#164949) (#170534) Related #202140, #164887, #203821 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @hartmark, @pash-openai, @jalehman, @jayzhou2309, @Hensarj, and @ArthurBook.
  • Telegram and WhatsApp: Keep Telegram receiving after update IDs restart, answer around failed attachment downloads, avoid replaying old topic context, and prevent WhatsApp reconnect notices from filling the session queue. (#201167) (#200682) (#202542) (#202637) (#191037) Related #190640 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @VACInc, @ericcurtin, and @sercada.
  • Discord and Teams: Reconnect all Discord accounts after network outages, preserve independent requests, transcribe voice using live settings, and avoid duplicated or truncated Teams stream fallback replies. (#201415) (#201518) (#202362) (#202368) (#158429) Related #162189, #158103 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @ericcaiwx-star, and @rdbartram.
  • Matrix, Feishu, and Mattermost: Avoid treating quoted bot mentions as new turns, render Matrix polls, preserve long Feishu replies, and deliver callback-button interactions correctly. (#197091) (#191700) (#161777) (#201973) Related #197065, #191678, #139443 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Jo2234, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, @ArthurNie, and @Simon2256928.
  • Voice and meetings: Keep meeting audio and captions active after join calls return, load existing Talk history, and support PostgreSQL-backed voice consultation indexes. (#191059) (#178415) (#201352) (#189036) (#189999) (#202103) Related #173896, #178413 Thanks @valkyriweb, @obviyus, @jeremynorris, @sukhdeepjohar, @davelutztx, @xena68, @ceckert, @etzelm, and @VACInc.
  • Browser and desktop: Read text from the correct page after navigation, preserve the user’s focused Chrome tab, capture background headless tabs, and keep desktop streams open during large updates. (#196659) (#134400) (#201626) (#202313) (#193487) Related #196658, #202267, #193444 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @martins-oss, @obviyus, @scotthuang, @honoyr, @SebTardif, and @lakemike.
  • Startup and pairing: Accept first chats while model catalogs load, keep readiness responsive, preserve startup restart handling, and show actionable pairing or setup guidance. (#201127) (#200370) (#201248) (#203530) (#202087) (#200905) (#202085) Related #202038, #202037 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @etzelm, @VACInc, @anmol0b, @LiuwqGit, and @sallyom.
  • Gateway responsiveness: Reduce stalls during plugin preparation and recovery, process launches, web extraction, filesystem pressure, and shell snapshot capture. (#200320) (#200374) (#198262) (#150564) (#197510) (#200925) (#201037) (#202407) Related #202374 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.
  • Database portability: Repair PostgreSQL schema-metadata mismatches, support ports back to SQLite, preserve backup restoration through symlinked targets, and handle large plugin blobs. (#197425) (#200383) (#201299) (#201867) (#197795) (#201862) (#201583) Related #196966, #200356, #201250, #197779, #201573 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @VACInc, @etzelm, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, @MasterSwords1, and @synapse-homeroot.
  • PostgreSQL reliability: Keep leases alive through lock contention, preserve the first operation after host suspension, speed up networked transcript migration, and retain numeric recall scores. (#201853) (#193875) (#201374) (#202304) (#201869) Related #201249 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, @VACInc, @ceckert, @deepujain, and @evemorgen.
  • SQLite and disk usage: Release snapshot and backup staging disk space, prioritize queued chat writes over page cleanup, and avoid repeatedly copying live state during read-only inspection. (#199666) (#201661) (#201445) (#202608) (#202765) (#203850) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @etzelm, @VACInc, @Alix-007, and @vincentkoc.
  • Update interruptions: Recover interrupted package publication and source updates after reboot, retain uncertain cases on the repair path, and preserve the installed command when old wrappers cannot be removed. (#200550) (#200680) (#201009) (#201361) (#200579) (#200613) (#201735) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @daniel-lxs, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Update contention: Continue updates around short-lived database readers and writers, settle shutdown writes, and keep plugin-contract or advisory warnings from unnecessarily rolling back core updates. (#200742) (#200569) (#201545) (#201330) (#202541) (#200507) (#202414) (#202310) Related #198072, #200022, #202384 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @zzs12345-web, @damzaru, @fuller-stack-dev, @vincentkoc, @fulgerulnegru, and @Anurag-5ingh.
  • Update compatibility: Handle prior updater handoffs, legacy statistics, pnpm global-store layouts, and Windows staged plugin dependencies; keep package files readable by non-root services. (#200532) (#201314) (#201914) (#202017) (#200595) (#193272) Related #200508, #200573 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrietv, @Leon-SK668, @fuller-stack-dev, @desksk, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Update status: Preserve failed-update reports and Inbox history, distinguish repairs from success, keep status queries responsive, and show plugin restart countdowns beside the update that needs them. (#202558) (#202678) (#202692) (#200687) (#201354) (#200431) Related #202657 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @machine3at, @vincentkoc, @EnesKartal, @etzelm, @TheAngryPit, @VACInc, @sallyom, @AyhamJo7, @hannesrudolph, and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Plugin follow-up: Retry owed plugin updates on schedule without ignoring Hold, retain pending repair work, and resolve version-like npm tags correctly. (#201178) (#201355) (#201678) (#201829) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev and @vincentkoc.
  • Doctor and installation: Retain recovery copies, restore truncated configuration, keep old Matrix heartbeat recovery available, preserve shell setup instructions, and avoid hanging the Linux installer at NodeSource. (#202322) (#201501) (#202651) (#201383) (#203538) (#202385) (#202312) Related #202382, #202309 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sukhdeepjohar, @VACInc, @etzelm, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Control UI: Keep answers outside collapsed work details, preserve mobile sidebar sections and keyboard layout, reconnect after app switches, and show menus in the Linux app. (#197429) (#202256) (#201291) (#199887) (#202500) (#201892) Related #199875, #202467 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @Marvinthebored, @vyctorbrzezowski, @Peetiegonzalez, @daniel-lxs, @obviyus, and @Mezetix.
  • Native apps: Avoid false low-memory failures on the first macOS chat, permit reopening after credential startup failures, keep iOS Talk replies ordered, and let Android Back dismiss the keyboard first. (#200373) (#201505) (#197136) (#202065) (#195974) Related #200340, #197129, #195949 Thanks @daniel-lxs, @RomneyDa, @jalehman, @jjjhenriksen, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @vyctorbrzezowski, @fuller-stack-dev, @saariuslystoned, and @Solvely-Colin.
  • Worktrees and sandboxes: Keep delayed managed-clone sessions and inherited project folders usable, support mounted state for custom Docker users, and avoid overlapping SSH file-tool failures. (#202525) (#202839) (#202792) (#202353) (#201807) (#202815) Related #202021 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @qodelicious, @henrylast42, and @ngutman.
  • Knowledge and memory: Provide usable Knowledge call shapes, keep the scribe progressing, exclude execution wake output from session indexing, and avoid indexing unused tool lookups. (#200339) (#202724) (#201062) (#201519) Related #196857 Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Ricardodpalmeida.

item.title: openclaw 2026.11.10-beta.2
item.description:
2026.11.10-beta.2

Highlights

  • Update recovery: keep OpenClaw runnable when package replacement is interrupted, and let the next update finish safely after a crash or reboot. (#200273, #200366, #200460, #200550, #200994) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable background work: preserve finished subagent results and resume their delivery after Gateway restarts, interrupted parent turns, and sibling activity. (#200279, #200649, #200249, #201544, #201563) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.
  • Faster first conversations: accept the first chat while model catalogs load, keep readiness checks responsive, and compact long histories without holding them entirely in Gateway memory. (#201127, #200370, #201304) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @garrytan.

Changes

  • Agent templates: open a durable chat before verified setup finishes, while retaining rollback authorization for newly created agents. (#196392, #200300) Related #196048 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @anmol0b.
  • Plugin side questions: let plugins fork a session’s live context for background work with their own tools and policy-controlled file and command access. (#170146, #190950, #200636) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Webhooks: accept bodies up to 1 MiB, report rejected requests, and fan out batched Gmail notifications. (#200514, #130002) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Secret-backed skill keys: preserve SecretRef values when keys are edited through the Skills page or skills.update instead of replacing references with plaintext. (#200539, #197319) Related #193149 Thanks @obviyus, @tommyjoseph, and @mmaps.

  • Permission boundaries: retain the admitted requester’s authority across restart recovery and native UI clients, and keep queued input from ending without a recorded cause. (#200394, #181363, #194443, #200433) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, @sallyom, @VACInc, and @obviyus.

  • Chat delivery: finish replies interrupted by Gateway restarts, preserve channel message IDs on oversized history entries, and reject stale-pane sends after a conversation branch switches. (#200553, #201698, #113073) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.

  • Subagent conversations: deliver completed results while siblings are still running or waiting, preserve each result under its requester turn, and stop sessions_send from blocking beyond its timeout. (#190999, #200967, #200873, #201373) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @obviyus, and @esqandil.

  • Live steering: deliver new instructions to busy subagents immediately, keep background turns running through configuration edits, and allow steering while a Code Mode command is active. (#200574, #200516, #200998) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @VACInc.

  • Automation continuity: retain scheduled work when chats, groups, or sharing change, preserve owner/account bindings across handoffs, and keep carried-over jobs running after updates. (#200314, #200396, #201434, #201008, #200653) Related #200307, #200600 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @hannesrudolph, @obviyus, @daniel-lxs, and @VACInc.

  • Automation outcomes: distinguish recovered tool errors, genuine tool failures, and successfully delivered reports; suppress notices for expected skips rather than reporting them as failed starts. (#201638, #107735, #139037, #120056, #152165, #186652, #194276, #200032) Related #102206, #116731, #194261, #200030 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @joshavant, @solavrc, @hartmark, @NarahariRaghava, @warren2008-2020-spec, @pash-openai, @wr-web, @slatem, and @daniel-lxs.

  • Telegram: keep receiving messages when update IDs restart, and answer messages even when an attachment cannot be downloaded. (#201167, #200682) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.

  • Discord and WhatsApp: reconnect all Discord accounts after network outages, preserve independent requests instead of replacing active tasks, and avoid flooding sessions with WhatsApp reconnect notices. (#201415, #201518, #191037) Related #162189, #190640 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @ericcurtin, and @sercada.

  • Matrix and Slack: prevent quoted bot mentions from starting new Matrix turns, render Matrix polls and votes in Element X, and retain Slack questions when an unauthorized person presses a button. (#197091, #191700, #201371) Related #197065, #191678, #201348 Thanks @Jo2234, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, and @shannon0430.

  • Media and meetings: expose inbound Twilio MMS photos to agents, retain long Feishu streaming replies, and keep meeting audio and captions alive after a join request returns. (#200890, #161777, #191059, #178415) Related #200804, #139443, #173896, #178413 Thanks @deepujain, @obviyus, @potterdigital, @ArthurNie, @Simon2256928, @valkyriweb, @jeremynorris, and @sukhdeepjohar.

  • Talk and mobile: load conversation history for fresh calls, keep iOS spoken replies beside the turn that prompted them, and avoid stale roles in approval alerts. (#201352, #197136, #200360) Related #197129 Thanks @davelutztx, @xena68, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @joshavant.

  • Claude CLI: retain final answers after progress and large tool results, avoid redoing completed tool work on fallback, and preserve long child results in completion turns. (#200501, #166127, #200801, #200470, #200226) Related #186967, #200744, #199633 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @Trinity-AI-Coder, @RTapiador, @fede-kamel, @jzmudzinski, @chaeyn, @etzelm, @VACInc, and @mulderp82.

  • Codex conversations: preserve instructions and oversized request content, recover media-only turns, avoid MCP name collisions, and retain line breaks in streamed replies. (#200690, #200735, #185186, #194831, #201102) Related #185079, #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @kaguranananana, @UHDPass, @lonexreb, @NicoBoom13, and @freeqaz.

  • Model discovery: discover new ChatGPT subscription models independently of npm releases, use published catalog limits, retain account reasoning limits, and keep healthy fallback models available. item.content:encoded:
2026.11.10-beta.2

Highlights

  • Update recovery: keep OpenClaw runnable when package replacement is interrupted, and let the next update finish safely after a crash or reboot. (#200273, #200366, #200460, #200550, #200994) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Reliable background work: preserve finished subagent results and resume their delivery after Gateway restarts, interrupted parent turns, and sibling activity. (#200279, #200649, #200249, #201544, #201563) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @obviyus.
  • Faster first conversations: accept the first chat while model catalogs load, keep readiness checks responsive, and compact long histories without holding them entirely in Gateway memory. (#201127, #200370, #201304) Related #195361 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @jalehman, and @garrytan.

Changes

  • Agent templates: open a durable chat before verified setup finishes, while retaining rollback authorization for newly created agents. (#196392, #200300) Related #196048 Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @anmol0b.
  • Plugin side questions: let plugins fork a session’s live context for background work with their own tools and policy-controlled file and command access. (#170146, #190950, #200636) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Webhooks: accept bodies up to 1 MiB, report rejected requests, and fan out batched Gmail notifications. (#200514, #130002) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @garrytan and @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Secret-backed skill keys: preserve SecretRef values when keys are edited through the Skills page or skills.update instead of replacing references with plaintext. (#200539, #197319) Related #193149 Thanks @obviyus, @tommyjoseph, and @mmaps.

  • Permission boundaries: retain the admitted requester’s authority across restart recovery and native UI clients, and keep queued input from ending without a recorded cause. (#200394, #181363, #194443, #200433) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, @sallyom, @VACInc, and @obviyus.

  • Chat delivery: finish replies interrupted by Gateway restarts, preserve channel message IDs on oversized history entries, and reject stale-pane sends after a conversation branch switches. (#200553, #201698, #113073) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.

  • Subagent conversations: deliver completed results while siblings are still running or waiting, preserve each result under its requester turn, and stop sessions_send from blocking beyond its timeout. (#190999, #200967, #200873, #201373) Related #188422 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @gouyu-hou, @obviyus, and @esqandil.

  • Live steering: deliver new instructions to busy subagents immediately, keep background turns running through configuration edits, and allow steering while a Code Mode command is active. (#200574, #200516, #200998) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, and @VACInc.

  • Automation continuity: retain scheduled work when chats, groups, or sharing change, preserve owner/account bindings across handoffs, and keep carried-over jobs running after updates. (#200314, #200396, #201434, #201008, #200653) Related #200307, #200600 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @hannesrudolph, @obviyus, @daniel-lxs, and @VACInc.

  • Automation outcomes: distinguish recovered tool errors, genuine tool failures, and successfully delivered reports; suppress notices for expected skips rather than reporting them as failed starts. (#201638, #107735, #139037, #120056, #152165, #186652, #194276, #200032) Related #102206, #116731, #194261, #200030 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus, @joshavant, @solavrc, @hartmark, @NarahariRaghava, @warren2008-2020-spec, @pash-openai, @wr-web, @slatem, and @daniel-lxs.

  • Telegram: keep receiving messages when update IDs restart, and answer messages even when an attachment cannot be downloaded. (#201167, #200682) Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.

  • Discord and WhatsApp: reconnect all Discord accounts after network outages, preserve independent requests instead of replacing active tasks, and avoid flooding sessions with WhatsApp reconnect notices. (#201415, #201518, #191037) Related #162189, #190640 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @mattreyes0824, @ericcurtin, and @sercada.

  • Matrix and Slack: prevent quoted bot mentions from starting new Matrix turns, render Matrix polls and votes in Element X, and retain Slack questions when an unauthorized person presses a button. (#197091, #191700, #201371) Related #197065, #191678, #201348 Thanks @Jo2234, @obviyus, @chelsealong, @geekforlife, and @shannon0430.

  • Media and meetings: expose inbound Twilio MMS photos to agents, retain long Feishu streaming replies, and keep meeting audio and captions alive after a join request returns. (#200890, #161777, #191059, #178415) Related #200804, #139443, #173896, #178413 Thanks @deepujain, @obviyus, @potterdigital, @ArthurNie, @Simon2256928, @valkyriweb, @jeremynorris, and @sukhdeepjohar.

  • Talk and mobile: load conversation history for fresh calls, keep iOS spoken replies beside the turn that prompted them, and avoid stale roles in approval alerts. (#201352, #197136, #200360) Related #197129 Thanks @davelutztx, @xena68, @obviyus, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @joshavant.

  • Claude CLI: retain final answers after progress and large tool results, avoid redoing completed tool work on fallback, and preserve long child results in completion turns. (#200501, #166127, #200801, #200470, #200226) Related #186967, #200744, #199633 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @Trinity-AI-Coder, @RTapiador, @fede-kamel, @jzmudzinski, @chaeyn, @etzelm, @VACInc, and @mulderp82.

  • Codex conversations: preserve instructions and oversized request content, recover media-only turns, avoid MCP name collisions, and retain line breaks in streamed replies. (#200690, #200735, #185186, #194831, #201102) Related #185079, #194825 Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, @kaguranananana, @UHDPass, @lonexreb, @NicoBoom13, and @freeqaz.

  • Model discovery: discover new ChatGPT subscription models independently of npm releases, use published catalog limits, retain account reasoning limits, and keep healthy fallback models available. (#201130, #201493, #200403, #200446, #200946) Related #201480 Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @VACInc.

  • Tool access: show required arguments for wide schemas and initial Knowledge tools, preserve full Tool Search pages, validate compact-tool arguments, and leave an empty tools.allow unrestricted. (#200064, #200339, #201487, #114461, #197590) Related #194857, #96115, #111704, #197552 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @lyrakat, @cbertucci33, @pallaoro, @wr-web, and @primepal2.

  • Browser control: keep page reads attached to the correct page after navigation, preserve the user’s focused Chrome tab, and allow screenshots of background tabs in headless mode. (#196659, #134400, #201626) Related #196658 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @martins-oss, @obviyus, and @scotthuang.

  • Install and update: tolerate concurrent database writers, preserve completed core updates when plugin or service refreshes need retrying, and finish when unchanged plugin configuration is read-only. (#200742, #201545, #201330, #200507, #200331, #201331) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.

  • Older installations: bridge older updater layouts, preserve valid archives, recover interrupted source-checkout updates, and retain package installs when an old wrapper cannot be removed. (#200662, #201314, #200659, #200733, #201009, #200579) Related #200594 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @SimonAIbot, and @fuller-stack-dev.

  • Linux and Windows updates: avoid RAM-backed temporary-directory exhaustion when TMPDIR is unset, accept pre-existing service drop-ins, validate staged Windows plugin dependencies, and redact Windows home paths from Doctor failure reports. (#199689, #197378, #200595, #200457) Related #197377, #200573, #200451 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @kitiyeung, @holgergruenhagen, @sallyom, @desksk, and @LolPanda2004.

  • Storage recovery: preserve PostgreSQL startup and backup restore paths, allow supported moves between SQLite and PostgreSQL, and speed up network database ports. (#197425, #193596, #197795, #200383, #201299, #201374) Related #196966, #197779, #200356, #201250, #201249 Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ceckert, @VACInc, @etzelm, @chelsealong, @evemorgen, and @deepujain.

  • History and responsiveness: reduce stalls in transcript searches, sparse-history reads, filesystem-heavy work, plugin reload recovery, and background page cleanup. (#200355, #201566, #200793, #197510, #200320, #200374, #201445) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc and @RomneyDa.

  • Desktop startup: let the macOS app answer its first chat and reopen after credential startup failures; finish VNC authentication before readiness probes close. (#200373, #201505, #193487) Related #200340, #193444 Thanks @jalehman, @jjjhenriksen, @SebTardif, @obviyus, and @lakemike.

  • Replay timestamps: preserve the original user-turn timestamp across attachment preparation and worker replay. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

  • Setup and authentication: discover cold account models before inference and classify model-route credential mismatches correctly. Thanks @RomneyDa, @daniel-lxs, @vincentkoc, and @DanCanadian.

  • Update diagnostics: retain nested handoff failure details and distinguish snapshot capacity failures from database corruption. Thanks @qodelicious, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @machine3at.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.10-beta.1..906bbc529b0bfd24a9108d124c1aeefe9acc0176 history: 356 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 356 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

item.title: openclaw 2026.11.10-beta.1
item.description:
2026.11.10-beta.1

Highlights

  • Agent templates: add agents directly from ClawHub packages, with a single CLAW.md manifest and bundled skill folders checked by the native trust flow. (#195707, #196322, #196348) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • OpenClaw ID: connect nodes through the ID tunnel, approve them from Access, and link owner devices to your own identity. (#193982, #194007, #197628) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Browser handoff: take over the agent’s browser directly from the Browser panel without stopping the agent. (#197928) Related #197902 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Chat control: send pending steering messages without stopping a run, edit queued messages, and retain composer drafts across app restarts. (#193665, #197846, #197908) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
  • Updates: configure automatic update schedules and let the incoming release run its own pre-update rehearsal. (#193713, #197922) Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @fuller-stack-dev.
  • State upgrades: migrate Gateway state using copy-and-swap at startup rather than modifying the live store in place. (#198389) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Durable execution: keep background commands running across Gateway restarts on macOS. (#197474) Related #197443 Thanks @daniel-lxs.

Changes

  • Access: add a guest member role with sandboxed session tools. (#197748) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Tool discovery: offer an opt-in usage-ranked tool index, including MCP tools. (#197128, #198348) Thanks @jalehman.
  • Knowledge: find current records when searches use wording from their superseded versions. (#193742) Related #193054 Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Voice and images: choose the speech-to-text model in Settings → Talk, and let agents review generated images before delivery. (#197906, #198227) Related #197859 Thanks @daniel-lxs and @vincentkoc.
  • Providers: support Parallel Decisions both natively and through OpenRouter. (#194537) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Backups: show stage and byte progress during long-running backups. (#198675) Thanks @vincentkoc.

Fixes

  • Access boundaries: apply OpenClaw ID member permissions consistently to HTTP history and connected-app panels. (#199946, #200070) Thanks @joshavant.
  • Queued input: show a visible withheld failure when permission is revoked instead of silently canceling the message. (#200213) Thanks @vincentkoc, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @obviyus.
  • Subagents: retain results through Gateway restarts and retry completion delivery after the requester is interrupted. (#199868, #200165) Authored by @steipete.
  • OpenAI responses: recover item conflicts across runs and complete replay-safe turns after deferred conflict recovery. (#199896, #200254) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @ZengWen-DT and @obviyus.
  • Slack delivery: preserve the final reply when native streams hit a boundary or message-length limit, and keep expired progress from appearing after the answer. (#199849, #200080) Related #200045 Thanks @n1hility, @obviyus, and @atlas-kring.
  • Discord: render edited messages consistently with new sends while preserving literal user-mention tokens inside code. (#199958, #200053) Related #190479, #195585 Thanks @obviyus, @yetval, and @saariuslystoned.
  • Signal: preserve native mention recipients in quoted messages. (#200058) Related #195074 Thanks @obviyus and @saariuslystoned.
  • Chat history: preserve reading position when transcript ranges shrink, load older history after interrupted restoration, and retain pasted text if the clipboard changes mid-paste. (#199747, #200107, #200098) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc and @obviyus.
  • Usage display: stop presenting fully unpriced usage as a known zero-dollar cost. (#199711) Related #199710 Thanks @JoshSalomon and @obviyus.
  • Update recovery: restrict startup copies and pruning to owned state and preserve successful startup writes for the next Doctor run. (#199929, #200260) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Responsiveness: reduce cold-session compaction CPU and latency regressions, prepare large histories outside the Gateway thread, and shorten write locks during large Knowledge vault scans. (#199561, #200114, #199859) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.

Complete contribution record

The full contribution record is available in the tag-pinned CHANGELOG.md.

Release verification

  • registry tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/openclaw/-/openclaw-2026.11.10-beta.1.tgz

  • release SHA: 995f9059b6e6fe3ba0865a3354924fd2bcbfceea
  • full release CI report: https://github.com/openclaw/releases/blob/main/evidence/2026.11.10-beta.1/release-evidence.md

item.title: openclaw 2026.10.33
item.description:
This is a gateway-only extended-stable release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of October 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is 2026.11.5

2026.10.33

This extended-stable release brings cumulative Gateway and core-plugin improvements since 2026.9.37, plus the selected maintenance fixes on the approved 2026.11.4 product baseline. Distribution covers the core npm package, matching official npm plugins, and Gateway Docker images; native-app releases are not included.

Highlights

  • Long conversations and large session stores use bounded export and recovery work, reducing out-of-memory failures during chat, memory export, Doctor repair, and Gateway startup. (#194066, #196158, #195459, #196480, #176737, #181289) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, @garrytan, and @oxen-horse.
  • Interrupted updates recover when their executor dies instead of leaving the Gateway stuck offline, while version-skew checks protect state still used by an installed service. (#181695, #186971, #187819) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @PonySlayer28, @tomdailey55, @jalehman, @fuller-stack-dev, and @vincentkoc.
  • Replies survive more restart and reconnect paths, preserving original prompts, recovering Telegram responses, and avoiding lost WhatsApp replies or skipped Signal messages. (#187157, #195400, #168778, #187667) Thanks @shakkernerd, @jason-allen-oneal, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
  • Shared-session privacy is stronger: Side chat stays private to its viewer, internal model prompts stay out of displayed output, and compaction redacts credentials in quoted summaries. (#185390, #173460, #197349) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @zhangguiping-xydt, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @obviyus.
  • Automations can react to polled conditions and MCP events, run repeatable scripts, and use explicitly allowed MCP servers. (#101195, #165399, #160996, #160995) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
  • Installed skills can be searched and read on demand, helping agents find relevant instructions without putting every installed skill into the prompt. (#158089, #158090, #158091, #160538) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Sessions can import existing Claude Code or Codex transcripts and move between local and cloud environments, with repository recipes and clearer cloud-startup progress. (#161955, #171690, #170862, #170895) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant and @RomneyDa.

Additional maintenance fixes

  • Provider continuity: preserve server compaction checkpoints across credential or model changes on the same provider API and endpoint, avoiding unnecessary history replay. (#200063, #200208) Thanks @obviyus.
  • macOS installation: preserve the controlling terminal during shell installation so onboarding can install plugins without detached Node subprocesses aborting. (#200247) Thanks @miguelbranco80.
  • Update recovery: record successful Gateway startup writes for the next Doctor run without accepting changes that predate startup. (#200260) Thanks @RomneyDa.
  • Existing device folders: recognize models using the implicit OpenClaw runtime without turning that default into an explicit session override. (#190065) Thanks @obviyus.
  • Plugin compatibility: retain the signed 2026.11.4 source baseline as this release's compatibility identity without changing its displayed version or lowering plugin API requirements. (#200302) Thanks @RomneyDa.

Changes

  • Session organization: snooze conversations, choose a custom wake time, and explicitly organize or archive nested conversations. (#161960, #171255, #168076) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jacobtomlinson.
  • Session context: show task progress in Details, indicate when a chat is waiting on helpers, and open the Subagents panel from the chat's helper count. (#161674, #164190, #166142) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @vyctorbrzezowski, and @shakkernerd.
  • Shared conversations: add emoji reactions to prompts and replies and configure when sessions may send or receive messages. (#161053, #162316) Authored by @steipete.
  • Workspace placement: start sessions in existing folders on paired devices or select hosted workspaces when creating sessions. (#169722, #168259) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus.
  • First-run setup: automatically choose inference and offer optional memory-embedding setup, including non-interactive embedding-only local setup. (#169628, #163693, #170153) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @PollyBot13 and @dh-js.
  • Memory providers: use a provider-neutral memory runtime with host-resolved audiences and provider-owned pre-compaction flushes. (#162175, #162176, #162177) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @jalehman.
  • Context management: use provider-native compaction on supported OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes, server-side compaction for ChatGPT sign-in sessions, and model fallback after context-overflow recovery. (#168164, #168401, #170141) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @aniketkrs, and @amirarenco-create.
  • Model setup: support endpoint-resolved custom aliases, show provider recommendations first, and display active authentication subscription blocks. (#170009, #167370, #133087) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @xyrolle, @Leon-SK668, and @vincentkoc.
  • Provider integrations: add Particle and Muse Code runtime support, including Muse sign-in through Model Setup. (#187135, #170487, #171526) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @obviyus.
  • Voice calls: add per-call briefs, reports, live steering, callbacks, and voicemail detection; OpenAI realtime voice can use a custom endpoint. (#165716, #165632) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jacobtomlinson and @mbelinky.
  • Microsoft Teams: support multiple bot accounts. (#112811) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jimmypuckett.
  • X integration: add mentions, GitHub-verified repository writers, guest repository questions, and daily/monthly API cost limits. (#165138, #168071, #165354, #165351) Authored by @steipete.
  • MCP apps: use apps across conversations and workspace files, keep an app's tool access while its view is open, and connect through a principal-bound relay. (#161747, #164496, #168233) Authored by @steipete.
  • Plugin interfaces: let plugins dock conversations, open session panels, and supply Solid-based Control UI views. (#161957, #163428, #168408) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @jalehman.
  • Plugin-assisted conversations: fork live context for background side questions and steer an active session through supported plugin operations. (#170146, #170152) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, and @obviyus.
  • Code Mode: retain store/load values across cells, replies, and restarts, and return wrapped browser observations for programmatic use. (#164086, #164833) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @alkor2000, and @potterdigital.
  • Backups: support external-disk and Cloudflare R2 destinations and preserve PostgreSQL-backed stores through backups and updates. (#161913, #170828) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant and @RomneyDa.
  • Database administration: add verified offline database-port operations with interrupted-port protection and replacement verification. (#170518, #171265, #171368) Authored by @steipete.
  • Cloud environments: group environments by repository, save suggested profiles on first use, and provision verified Node toolchains. (#170892, #170875, #170796) Authored by @steipete.
  • Control UI: customize branding and session backgrounds, play YouTube videos inline, fold code in diffs, and use terminal fonts with Nerd Font icons. (#168027, #168301, #164576, #172350, #166180) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @jacobtomlinson.
  • Navigation and language: use a compact personal sidebar rail, return to Discord or Slack from session headers, and use Swedish localization. (#168325, #158742, #62063) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, @yeager, and @vincentkoc.
  • Installation: offer an opt-in pinned Bun runtime and standalone executables. (#168832, #172384) Authored by @steipete.

Fixes

  • Update recovery: reclaim offline maintenance after a dead update executor so the Gateway can start again without manual database repair. (#181695) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @PonySlayer28.
  • Update compatibility: avoid premature state migrations, keep unrelated or older installed services from blocking valid configuration and Doctor operations, and retain plugin lifecycle ownership during lengthy finalization. (#186971, #187870, #187886, #187966, #190194, #196474, #188404) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @tomdailey55, @shakkernerd, and @Satoshi-Kusumoto.
  • Installation diagnostics: fail clearly when Homebrew bootstrap fails, handle shell characters in private CLI install paths, start Windows setup after npm-shim installation, and use a private workspace when the system temporary directory is unsafe. (#187688, #189541, #185309, #187737) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @McgAtom, @obviyus, @DonnieFi, and @Yachiyo1680.
  • Large histories: bound transcript trimming, indexing, memory export, and Doctor repair to avoid exhausting worker or Gateway memory. (#194066, #196158, #195459, #196480) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
  • Startup responsiveness: narrow session recovery reads and avoid delaying plugin startup on large session stores. (#176737, #181289) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @oxen-horse.
  • Persistent state: preserve PostgreSQL commit durability, settle staged authority at physical commit, and recover chats after database connection loss. (#180821, #193842, #181661) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Files: reject stale saves after the workspace has been replaced instead of writing into the wrong workspace state. (#178336) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
  • Shared-session privacy: keep another viewer's Side chat and private model prompt projections out of displayed content. (#185390, #173460) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen and @obviyus.
  • Secrets: redact credentials in quoted compaction output and keep Skills-page key saves from replacing SecretRefs with plaintext. (#197349, #197319) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @obviyus and @mmaps.
  • Configuration safety: reject reserved assignment keys, preserve restrictive allowlists after filtering, keep disabled mixed-case plugins disabled, and avoid catalog imports beside stored SecretRefs. (#191389, #190068, #188846, #179802) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @wangmiao0668000666, @yetval, @masatohoshino, and @ensignwesley.
  • Tool authority: require effective approval for delegated changes, check prepared images through input-policy hooks, and reject late or ambiguous capability-scoped attachment requests. (#196984, #196337, #159106, #190863) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @joshavant, @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @sallyom, and @arpe1618.
  • Sandbox upgrades: protect writable ancestors of nested skill mounts, prepare protected mount sources at first launch, and resume turns after mount additions. (#180840, #182412, #182789) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @eleqtrizit, @momothemage, and @akang1798.
  • Repository and ingestion boundaries: restrict limited roles to public repositories and reject special files during memory-wiki ingestion. (#194830, #187621) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @Leon-SK668, and @obviyus.
  • Restart delivery: preserve original prompts, recover Telegram final replies, and keep WhatsApp responses and Signal inbound messages across reloads or reconnects. (#187157, #195400, #168778, #187667) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @shakkernerd, @jason-allen-oneal, @mcaxtr, @HermanZeng, and @obviyus.
  • Telegram and IRC: deliver agent inline-button taps before expiry and honor explicitly empty IRC channel sender lists. (#196217, #196293) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, @kkernan, and @mmaps.
  • Streaming responsiveness: prevent long non-streaming Slack reasoning and deeply nested progress-label paths from freezing the Gateway. (#196250, #196282) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ptu-gh, @obviyus, and @LeizhenZhang.
  • Automation completion: retain session-targeted cron and system-event replies, prepare completion permissions before loading requester state, and release suspended helper completions correctly. (#196750, #197434, #197323) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @jlapenna, @RomneyDa, @1052326311, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @holgergruenhagen, and @wr-web.
  • Code Mode execution: settle failed calls, bound silent streams, retain process results at suspended-run capacity, and stop cleanly after reply-decoding memory exhaustion. (#196435, #196927, #188023) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Claude sessions: avoid startup deadlocks and first-turn failures following cancelled login checks during token refresh. (#173011, #197032) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ericcaiwx-star, @sopa-gpters, @obviyus, and @kir1ll.
  • Provider recovery: retain quota recovery across concurrent sessions, accept retained Z.AI Coding Plan models, remove invalid Gemini schema enums, and bound silent native-session startup. (#176602, #195390, #196742, #196517) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @jason-allen-oneal, @obviyus, and @yixiaoer-520.
  • Conversation continuity: keep active turns running across automatic rollover, preserve canonical reconstructed context, and release memory after non-announcing helpers finish. (#197345, #194362, #196672) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @ceckert, @obviyus, @gloss-dandelion-cult, @sunlit-deng, @maxdjohnson, @vincentkoc, @Jo2234, @abacha, @rabsef-bicrym, and @jalehman.
  • Plugin lifecycle: avoid holding the state writer during initial admission, prevent configuration-only restarts from hanging reloads, and keep official plugin selectors on the stable channel. (#182117, #182331, #194812) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, and @DonnieFi.
  • Cloud preparation: bootstrap private QA builds correctly and avoid falsely reporting unsaved work during fresh guest PR preparation. (#181824, #185777) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.
  • Doctor and recovery: support startup with conflicting legacy exec approvals, avoid read-only database copies on full disks, reject incomplete database-port success, and skip missing sanitized config companions when nothing remains to import. (#196401, #196346, #194595, #186998) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @fuller-stack-dev, @ylcn91, @reisball, and @AlyaKoni.
  • Workspace readiness: do not mistake sandbox-written files for Gateway readiness, and preserve command outcomes when shutdown fails. (#197248, #188891) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @mmaps.
  • Session navigation: keep touch links clear of row actions and prevent Doctor repairs from renaming the main session to an internal heartbeat marker. (#194840, #179219) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @VACInc, @Satoshi-Kusumoto, @RomneyDa, @najef1979-code, and @vyctorbrzezowski.
